data.name: Razor-Sharp Chair Leg
data.description: At 9th level, as a swift action, a cad may alter the type of damage dealt by an improvised weapon to bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. In addition, the cad has a critical threat range of 19-20/x2 with any improvised melee weapon. This ability replaces weapon training 2.
